svg.title: 100 agents: separate processes or one shared Rui Host
svg.desc: An illustrative process-per-agent design repeats a heap, threads and a provider connection in each of 100 processes. Rui instead uses one Host with SQLite, one execution event loop and up to 100 model streams on one shared HTTP/2 connection at Active Capacity 100 and one provider origin. Processes 3 through 99 and streams 3 through 99 are aggregated, not omitted from the count. The Host also has shared worker threads, and Bash tools run as subprocesses. Provider stream limits can queue work. This is architecture, not a measured performance comparison or a depiction of the historical HTTP/1.1 fixture. An opaque light canvas preserves the same contrast on light and dark pages.
svg.metadata: Source revision: b250c8c397a95001ccbbe52c8f7985d183f0a8b8, DivyanshGolyan/rui. Source owners: src/provider.zig Reactor.init (ceil(capacity/100) connections, 100 streams per connection); src/server_execution.zig executionMain (one execution loop and capacity-sized slots); src/server.zig (Host custody array and execution thread). Contracts: ARCHITECTURE.md, Capacity ownership; Model requests, continuation and compaction; Tool excerpts and full output. H1 evidence boundary: tests/qualification/README.md, Model output. Left side is an explicitly illustrative topology, not a measured competitor. Theme: fixed opaque #f8fafc canvas and explicit colors; no inherited page colors. Intended reading width: 720–960 CSS pixels. No external fonts or assets.
svg.text: Architecture comparison · counts describe topology, not benchmark results
Scope: up to 100 live model streams; peer limits may queue requests.
One execution loop ≠ one Host thread. Shared workers and Bash subprocesses remain.
H2 architecture is separate from historical loopback HTTP/1.1 benchmark evidence.
